D/ DN VALENTINI ANVS PF AVG ; R/ [GLORIA ROMANORVM]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Valentinian I (364-375), Emperor right issue of 364-375, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust pearl diademed right. Obverse inscription: DN VALENTINI ANVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right holding labarum and dragging captive. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Diameter: 18.8mm, Weight: 2.20gms, die axis: 6
